## Why visit

An unusually useful small-town stop for a trip between Manchester and Liverpool. The converted-shop bar combines a substantial changing cask range with a quiet, conversational setting, and CAMRA specifically notes a dark beer among the selection. Its proximity to Newton-le-Willows station makes a deliberately planned break plausible, but the restricted opening pattern means it cannot be assumed on any transfer day. Choose it when the train and opening times align, or as part of a focused local outing. Real cider and bottles broaden the visit beyond a quick cask tasting.

## Beer

CAMRA’s June 2026 survey records eight changing real ales, including a dark beer, plus craft keg and bottles.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly marks real cider and reports two traditional ciders; also on the branch’s 2026 cider-award shortlist. Check current products.

## Plan the visit

Official site lists Thursday–Sunday opening only, with Thursday starting in the evening. Over-18s venue. Check your train’s actual stopping pattern.

**Getting there:** Near Newton-le-Willows station on the High Street; confirm onward trains before using it as a transfer-day stop.
